Omanyte

Rock Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Omanyte is a Rock/Water-type Spiral Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 7.5 kg. It evolves into Omastar. Its highest base stat is Defense (100), with a base stat total of 355.
